title: MemoryBundleSnapshot
description: Memory v1: every operator-declared memory bundle Cockpit can render, with its members and health (GET /api/v1/registry/memory/bundles). Cockpit serves it, the Control Plane consumes it. Closed objects; bundles sorted by id, members by path, tags and repoScopes sorted. snapshotDigest covers bundles (health included) and not observedAt. Normative text: docs/contracts/memory-v1.md.

snapshotDigest.description: sha256 over the RFC 8785 JSON of `bundles`.

observedAt.description: When Cockpit read the memory files for this snapshot. The time base for every age in it. Not digested.

bundleId.description: The bundle v1 memory bundle id pattern.

memberPath.description: A memory file relative to the bundle's memory/ directory: no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segment, no backslash or NUL, ending in .md. Cockpit v1 emits a single file name.

digest.description: The registry v1 asset digest over the members: sha256 of `<hex member digest> <path>\n` lines sorted by path bytes. Recomputable from members.

repoScopes.description: Repositories as `owner/name`. Empty exactly when visibility is any_repo.

visibility.description: repo_scoped: offered only to tasks in repoScopes. any_repo: offered to any task. Neither is rendered unless a composition pins it.

digest.description: sha256 of the file's raw bytes.

estimatedTokens.description: Cockpit's estimate for rendering every member. Advisory.

Health.description: Garden findings whose nodes are members of this bundle, as Cockpit computed them at observedAt.

members.description: Equals the length of the bundle's members.

staleMembers.description: Members older than the Garden's staleDays, age from frontmatter metadata.modified before file mtime. At most members.

oldestAgeDays.description: Whole days from the oldest member's age basis to observedAt. null exactly when the bundle has no members.

findingsDigest.description: Opaque to the plane: changes exactly when the findings behind these counts change.
